channel.title: GATE Guide — free GATE 2027 guides
channel.description: Free GATE 2027 guides for CSE, ECE, CE, DA, EE and ME: syllabus, weightage, important topics and preparation, by MD ANISH AHAMAD.

item.title: Electromagnetics for GATE ECE 2027: Important Topics and Patterns
item.description: GATE ECE Electromagnetics counted across five EC papers. The topics that recur with question numbers, what the 2027 syllabus kept, and how to prepare it.

item.title: GATE CSE Answer Key: How to Check It and Raise a Challenge
item.description: How to read the GATE CSE provisional answer key, match it to your response sheet, judge MSQ and NAT entries, and decide whether a challenge is worth raising.

item.title: GATE CE Qualifying Marks and Cutoffs Explained
item.description: GATE CE qualifying marks for 2024, 2025 and 2026 from the official cut-off pages, the formula behind them, and why admission cutoffs are different.

item.title: GATE ME 2027 Registration, Exam Dates and Application Fee
item.description: GATE ME 2027 registration step by step. The GOAPS window, the fee for each category, the 6 to 21 February 2027 exam window and the 19 March result date.

item.title: GATE DA Syllabus Topics Never Asked in Any Paper Yet
item.description: GATE DA topics never asked in 2024, 2025 or 2026, from confidence intervals to LU and linked lists, with a short reading of each and why the zero proves little.

item.title: GATE EE 6-Month Study Plan, Week by Week
item.description: A 26-week GATE EE study plan in a sensible section order, with mathematics and aptitude from week one and room for a full first learning of every section.

item.title: Communications for GATE ECE 2027: Important Topics and Patterns
item.description: GATE ECE Communications counted across five EC papers. The topics that recur with question numbers, the one 2027 syllabus change, and how to prepare it.

item.title: GATE CSE 2026 Paper Analysis: Both Shifts, Subject by Subject
item.description: GATE CSE 2026 paper analysis from analyst compilations. Shift 1 marks, shift 2 question counts, question types, difficulty, and what it signals for 2027.

item.title: Transportation Engineering for GATE CE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE CE Transportation Engineering important topics from all sixteen papers of 2019 to 2026, covering traffic flow, highways, pavements, railways and airports.

item.title: GATE ME 2027 by IIT Madras: What It Does and Does Not Change
item.description: IIT Madras organises GATE 2027 but set none of the six ME papers from 2022 to 2026. Why no IIT Madras style can be read from them, and what it has decided.

item.title: GATE DA Most Repeated Topics Across All Three Papers
item.description: GATE DA most repeated topics, ranked. The 25 topic groups that drew marks in all three papers, 2024 to 2026, and the 195 of 300 marks they carry between them.

item.title: How to Score 50 in GATE EE in 4 Months
item.description: How to score 50 in GATE EE in four months, built from the counted 2022 to 2026 papers: which marks to secure first, which to build, and which are stretch.

item.title: Control Systems for GATE ECE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE ECE control systems counted across five EC papers. 40 marks in 24 questions, the bands that recur, what PID in the 2027 syllabus means, and a study order.

item.title: Sorting Algorithm Questions in GATE CSE: Comparisons and Properties
item.description: Sorting algorithms for GATE CSE in one comparison table. Best and worst cases, comparison counts, stability, quicksort partition traces, radix sort.

item.title: Transportation Planning for GATE CE 2027: The Four-Step Model
item.description: Transportation Planning is new in the GATE CE 2027 syllabus with no past question behind it. The four-step travel demand model explained, step by step.

item.title: GATE ME Question Types: How Many MCQ, MSQ and NAT Questions
item.description: How many MCQ, MSQ and NAT questions the six GATE ME papers from 2022 to 2026 set, why MSQs fell to zero, and what each type means for guessing.

item.title: Best Order to Study GATE DA Subjects for 2027
item.description: The best order to study GATE DA subjects, built on counted marks from 2024-2026 and adjusted for dependencies such as linear algebra before PCA.

item.title: GATE EE 2027 Preparation Strategy: A Staged Plan
item.description: A GATE EE 2027 preparation strategy in four stages: learn in a sensible order, read the never-asked topics, use the five past papers, then mocks and revision.

item.title: Digital Circuits for GATE ECE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE ECE digital circuits counted across five EC papers. 49 marks in 32 questions, the templates that repeat, an unchanged 2027 syllabus and a study order.

item.title: Propositional Logic Questions in GATE CSE: Tautologies and Arguments
item.description: How to solve GATE CSE propositional logic questions fast. Tautology and equivalence checks, counting satisfying assignments, and testing arguments.
